To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the system cascade design for plasma shape and current in ramp-up phase was developed, 2) the plasma current and shape tracking was successfully simulated, 3) the system cascade can be used in ITER, 4) the system can transfer from ramp-up phase to stationary regime without change of structure, 5) the plasma vertical instability was successfully modeled, 6) the plasma vertical speed was successfully suppressed.

the designed control system is capable of plasma current ramp-up tracking with high precision and fast response, and the system can be transferred to quasi-stationar regime in plasma current flat-top phase without any controller structure change.
the proposed system is able to provide a good control quality for plasma current and plasma shape in the plasma current ramp-up regime.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of the magnetic control system for plasma current ramp-up on the ITER tokamak.
the design and modeling of the magnetic control system for plasma current ramp-up on ITER.
the design of the plasma current and shape control system and the plasma vertical stability system in the plasma current ramp-up scenario on ITER.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the designed control system for plasma magnetic control in ITER ramp-up phase has been shown to be able to track plasma current and shape with high accuracy.
the system has been developed and tested on the DINA code.
the system design was successful and the results of simulations are in accordance with the ITER reference scenarios.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the cascade tracking system for the ITER plasma magnetic control in plasma current ramp up stage was designed, modeled, and tested on DINA code.
the cascade tracking system for the plasma current and shape is designed and modeled on DINA code in the plasma current ramp-up scenario.
we have developed a new control system for plasma magnetic control system for ITER in ramp-up stage and we have modeled it on DINA code.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cascade tracking system can be used for plasma shape and plasma current control during plasma ramp-up stage.
the cascade tracking system can be used for plasma current and plasma shape tracking in plasma current ramp up phase.
the cascade control of plasma shape and position is a feasible and effective method for plasma magnetic control.
